usedFor: Harvestr collects user feedback and Calendly books the follow-up, so “New Submitter” can lead to “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submitter” in Harvestr, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Someone who just gave feedback is worth a call, and the link makes that easy to offer.

watchOut: “New Submitter” in Harvestr is polling, so the link is created after a scheduled check.
